# Gigafactory 3X

> Gigafactory 3X engineers AI-powered manufacturing ecosystems — robotics, advanced automation, battery systems, semiconductors, digital twins and clean energy — for global industry.

Gigafactory 3X builds intelligent industrial infrastructure at giga-scale. The public site covers our technologies, the industries we serve, our research and innovation programs, investor outlook, and careers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Gigafactory 3X, our intelligent industry platform and global operations.
- [About](/about): Who we are, what we build and why we exist.
- [Core Technologies](/technologies): Artificial intelligence, robotics, advanced manufacturing, battery systems, semiconductors, industrial automation and digital twins.
- [Industries](/industries): Manufacturing, energy, aerospace, logistics, smart cities, infrastructure and government solutions.
- [Global Infrastructure](/infrastructure): Campuses, regional capacity, facility types and grid/logistics integration.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Clean generation, circular manufacturing, decarbonisation roadmap and ESG governance.
- [Innovation](/innovation): Research labs, patents, engineering programs and next-generation technologies.
- [Investors](/investors): Growth strategy, sustainability, governance and corporate outlook.
- [News & Press](/news): Press releases, announcements and media coverage.
- [Careers](/careers): Engineering culture, internships and global opportunities.
- [Contact](/contact): Global headquarters, regional offices and support.
- [Search](/search): Search pages and sections across the site.


## Guides

- [Smart Factory Guide](/resources/smart-factory-guide): Smart factory architecture, phased rollout, economics and FAQ on smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0.
